content.text:
My family
Dis ton prénom et ton âge.
Say your name and age in French.
Identify family members using mon père, ma mère, mon frère, ma sœur, mes parents and mes grands-parents, choosing mon, ma or mes to match the French noun.
Describe a family member’s name, age and one personality trait using il/elle s’appelle…, il/elle a… ans and il/elle est…, with correct agreement of gentil/gentille and amusant/amusante.
Write a short description of your own or an imaginary family using j’ai… and je n’ai pas de… to describe siblings, followed by details about one family member’s name, age and personality.
Montre et dis : qui est qui ?
All three mean “my”. Match the French noun, not the person speaking.

elements.name: Diagram
elements.alt: Mon goes with père and frère; ma with mère and sœur; mes with parents and grands-parents.

content.text: Léa says “my brother”. Which is correct?
Mon frère s’appelle Hugo. Il a douze ans. Il est gentil.
il/elle a… ans = he/she is… years old

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: A boy offers picked-up books to another child, who smiles at him.
elements.request: an imaginary boy helping a younger child pick up dropped books. boy helping child. books on ground. friendly facial expression

content.text: Name: Louis. Write “My brother’s name is Louis”.

Écris trois phrases. / Write three sentences.
il s’appelle… • il a… ans • il est…

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: A smiling teenage boy playing a colourful board game, with the game clearly visible.
elements.request: an imaginary brother smiling during a family game. smiling teenage boy. colourful board game

content.text:
Il est gentil ou amusant.
He is kind or funny.

elements.name: Photo
elements.alt: A smiling teenage girl playing a colourful board game, with the game clearly visible.
elements.request: an imaginary sister smiling during a family game. smiling teenage girl. colourful board game

content.text:
Elle est gentille ou amusante.
She is kind or funny.
J’ai un frère. Je n’ai pas de sœur.
I have…: un frère / une sœur
I don’t have any…: de frère / de sœur

elements.name: Diagram
elements.alt: This speaker has one brother and no sisters.

content.text: À toi : les frères et sœurs
Brothers: 0. Write “I don’t have any brothers”.

Écris deux phrases. / Write two sentences.
J’ai… • Je n’ai pas de…
un frère = a brother • une sœur = a sister
You have one sister and no brothers. Write two sentences.
Your sister is Zoé, aged 12 (douze). Write her name and age.
She is funny. Write her personality.

Écris cinq phrases. / Write five sentences.
frère • sœur • il/elle s’appelle… • il/elle a… ans • il/elle est…
gentil/gentille = kind • amusant/amusante = funny
Choose a real or imaginary family. Write what siblings you have and do not have.
Choose one family member. Write their name, age and one personality trait.
Défi / Stretch: add a second family member with a different trait.
Écris un petit paragraphe. / Write a short paragraph.
